purpose: First dynamic test of the same-model prequalified A/B router after current integration; report actual results without tuning to a target

configuration.chip: Use the byte-pinned training-chip P as the source; no new mismatch draw or coefficient fit
configuration.mismatch_dem_physical_dither: inherit the frozen training-chip profile, enabled
configuration.az_ktc_aperture_jitter_random_ra_noise: off, as in the registered RX qualification profile
configuration.bank: two versions with the same frozen h; publish at sample ID 4; no retire or drain claim

comparisons: Nominal OFF, legacy Frozen, and Bank ON use the same input, chip, public plan, IDs and epoch
Require 256 consecutive valid RX records and exact ID/epoch/code-valid joins
Compare old non-code logs and public RAW on the same event axis
Compute SNR, SNDR, SFDR, THD and ENOB from each actual saved integer code record
Preserve spectrum, P, SLX, source manifest, simout and raw codes

gates.snr_sndr_sfdr_thd_enob_numeric_threshold: none; report actual values and limitations
gates.qualification_or_profile_rejection: stop and report; do not change this protocol silently

not_claimed: Background training, consumer drain or slot reuse
